seasons.title: Season 1: Building Model IQ Foundations
seasons.theme: Introduction to Model Selection and Azure AI
seasons.description: Season 1 introduces the Model Mondays format and covers foundational topics in model selection, evaluation, and deployment using Microsoft Foundry and GitHub Models.

seasons.title: Season 2: Advanced Model Techniques
seasons.theme: Deep Dive into Reasoning, Multimodal, and Specialized Models
seasons.description: Season 2 explores advanced topics including reasoning models, multimodal AI, model customization, and real-world customer implementations.

seasons.title: Season 3: Models for Beginners Integration
seasons.theme: Learning Through Practice with Models for Beginners Curriculum
seasons.description: Season 3 integrates structured learning with the Models for Beginners curriculum, featuring weekly lessons alongside spotlights on Microsoft Ignite announcements and practical implementations.

seasons.title: Season 4: Model Spotlights for Agent Builders
seasons.theme: Model spotlights for building effective AI agents
seasons.description: Season 4 explores model families and model-selection practices for agent builders, including proprietary, open, multimodal, speech, and fine-tuned models.
